title: Leaving Dreamland for San Francisco in 1921
summary: Oliver went to the Royal Garden, then the band moved to the Pecola dance hall in San Francisco, leaving Chicago May 30, 1921.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
